maddeler.e:
نتقاطر (form VI)
# نَتَقَاطَرُ (nataqāṭaru) /na.ta.qaː.tˤa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَاطَرَ (taqāṭara)
# نَتَقَاطَرَ (nataqāṭara) /na.ta.qaː.tˤa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَاطَرَ (taqāṭara)
# نَتَقَاطَرْ (nataqāṭar) /na.ta.qaː.tˤar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَاطَرَ (taqāṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
